mod_compile.note_on_load_mechanisms: Modern NEURON places libnrnmech.so directly in x86_64/ (not in x86_64/.libs/ as older versions did). 'load_mechanisms(x86_64)' from Python returns False because it looks for the legacy path, but hasattr(h, 'bkt80') etc. all return True because NEURON auto-loads x86_64/libnrnmech.so from CWD on import. This matches t0112/t0113/t0114/t0115/t0122/t0123's observation exactly. Library size 118704 bytes is byte-identical to t0114/t0115/t0122/t0123 library size (same Linux ABI, same Zen-class AMD64 target, same NEURON 8.2.7 build).
